name: hmi_add_button
description: Add or update a button on a screen with text, position, colors, pressed state tag, and OnClick/Tapped JavaScript script.

pressed_tag.description: HMI tag to bind to button pressed state (optional).

tapped_script.description: JavaScript code to execute on button tap (e.g. Tags.SysFct.InvertBitInTag("tag", 0);).
